message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1‑9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck. 2. Deal 7 cards to each player. 3. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile. 4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first turn goes clockwise; a “Reverse” card flips the direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the color or the number/symbol of the top discard. If you have a Wild card, you can play it on any card and choose the new color. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise your turn ends. | | **UNO Call** | When you have **exactly one card left**, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, the round ends. The winner scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by the other players: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the target score (commonly 500) wins. You can also play a single round for a quick game. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep a mix of colors** – it gives you more options to play. 2. **Save Wild Draw Fours** – they’re powerful but risky; use them when you’re sure you’re forced to play. 3. **Watch the discard pile** – if someone plays a “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four,” you might be able to counter with the same card if you have it. 4. **UNO Challenge** – if you suspect a player illegally played a Wild Draw Four, you can challenge. If they’re wrong, they draw six cards; if they’re right, you draw four. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
